newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end higher with tight liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end higher with tight liquidity.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed higher on Thursday as the banking system continued to show a negative reserve excess following recent mop-up measures by the central bank, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate ended at 6.477 percent against Wednesday's 6.026 close -- above the central bank's target zone of 5.0-5.5 percent -- with 30-day commercial paper at 6.50-6.75 percent against 6.15-6.25.
The rates' rise came despite Thursday's maturation of T$5 billion in negotiable certificates of deposit.
Dealers said operations of the banking system have stayed conservative since the central bank issued T$10 billion NCDs on Tuesday.
But they expected the market to stabilise on Friday.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 5.8350-8360 percent against 5.8365.
